jobs.name: Website · Satin arc
jobs.direction: Website-family variation: restrained and editorial. Retain broad matte-black negative space. Replace the original single diagonal red sweep with one elegant deep-red satin arc that starts narrow at lower left, gradually broadens across the lower third and curves up toward the right seam. Add only one very fine silver companion edge along the arc. Keep the flavour and quantity neatly left aligned below the graphic. No grunge or busy stripes. A calm expensive design, visually distinct from the reference but unmistakably the Website family.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE photorealistic premium TRAYN NUTRITION whey-protein stand-up resealable pouch, portrait 2:3, 1024x1536 or equivalent higher resolution. Reference image 1 establishes this product's design family and pouch proportions. Reference image 2 is the mandatory user-approved exact stacked silver logo: angular T symbol, custom TRAYN lettering, NUTRITION and its horizontal rules. Preserve those logo shapes, proportions and metallic finish closely; do not substitute another font or redesign the identity. Full front view with the entire pouch visible, realistic matte-black laminate, subtle fine grain, believable folds and zipper seal, refined silver branding, legible large condensed white WHEY. Controlled studio product photography on a neutral charcoal background and floor with soft directional highlights, consistent frontal camera framing. Produce a new package graphic variation within this family. Exact text only, clearly readable: 'TRAYN', 'NUTRITION', 'WHEY', 'Whey Protein Concentrate + Whey Protein Isolate Blend', 'Belgian Chocolate', 'Net Quantity: 500 g', 'Contains Milk', and small 'PACKAGING CONCEPT — NOT FOR SALE'. Descriptor appears once, full wording on two or three clean lines below WHEY. No extra text, claims, icons, badges, nutrition facts or seals. No WPC/WPI abbreviations. Keep logo and all product text unobstructed. Output a single individual render, not a sheet, collage or multiple pouches.

jobs.name: Website · Precision sweep
jobs.direction: Website-family variation: clean architectural refinement of the single red sweep. Use one crisp vermilion diagonal ribbon across the lower third, rising from the left seam toward the right seam; add a fine offset brushed-silver line separated by a generous black gap. Make the ribbon an elegant tapered blade rather than a broad panel. Maintain quiet black upper two-thirds and immaculate typography with a slightly more structured lower flavour block. No grunge, no decorative symbol or new wording. Clearly different from the curved Satin arc option.

jobs.name: Performance · Velocity
jobs.direction: Performance-family variation: dynamic premium sport packaging. Keep energetic red and silver diagonal bands sweeping upward from lower-left to upper-right, like the Performance reference, but make the bands smoother and more disciplined. One broad deep-red metallic stroke wraps the lower half, accompanied by two narrower brushed-silver speed strokes with subtle feathered edges. Keep the upper logo area clean. Fine material texture only, no excessive scratches or distress on the lettering. Energetic yet legible, visually distinct from the reference.

jobs.name: Performance · Cutline
jobs.direction: Performance-family variation: graphic motorsport precision. Keep the black, red and silver diagonal energy but translate the brush strokes into crisp interlocking angled ribbons with clear black gaps. A strong red diagonal forms the lower-right field, a brushed-silver diagonal passes behind but never through the product descriptor, and a narrow red speed accent balances the upper-right shoulder. Silver must remain a secondary graphic, not a silver all-over pouch. Preserve the centered logo and WHEY hierarchy, keep all text on clean black reading zones. No grunge, no carbon-fiber pattern, no extra text. Clearly different from the softer Velocity option.
